thread:
marco: Starting quick deploy for conv-svc v1.8. Release: batching tweaks + tiny tokenizer change. Feature flag `conv_v1_8` will be rolled 0% -> 25% with an initial canary at 2% pinned to model=1.8. Change window 23:00-00:30 UTC. @deploy-bot start canary pls.

deploy-bot: Canary run initiated (id=canary-5261234567). Applied conv_v1_8=2%, model pin model=1.8 for cohort. Artifact: https://ci.internal/artifacts/conv-svc/v1.8/5261234567

sara: Heads-up: last patch had a spike in p95 for edge users when batch>=10. Recommend limiting batch_max=8 for canary.

marco: Good catch. Setting cohort config batch_max=8 before ramp.

deploy-bot: Applied config: batch_max=8 for cohort canary-5261234567.

ryan: I'll watch p95 and error rate. Auto-hold if errors>0.4% or p95>baseline+70ms for 5m.

ops-bot: Canary metrics (t+9m): errors=0.06%, p95=190ms. No alerts.

marco: Proceed to 10% at +10m. deploy-bot please ramp.

deploy-bot: Ramp executed: conv_v1_8=10% (`/ff set conv_v1_8 10 --by=deploy-bot --note=step1`)

ops-bot: Metrics (t+22m): errors=0.5%, p95=305ms. Alert: error_rate > 0.4% for 5m.

marco: Pausing rollout. Rolling down to 3% to reduce blast radius and keep pin. Command: `/ff set conv_v1_8 3 --note="stepdown-on-alert"`

ml-bot: Observed correlation between tokenizer change and failed parse on long messages. Suggest revert tokenizer while keeping batching tweak.

marco: Agreed. Revert tokenizer on cohort and keep batch_max=8. Commands queued: `/config set tokenizer=legacy --selector=cohort:canary-5261234567` and `/ff set conv_v1_8 3 --note="tokenizer-revert"`

deploy-bot: Applied tokenizer revert and set conv_v1_8=3%.

ops-bot: Post-mitigation metrics (t+42m): errors=0.08%, p95=200ms. Stable.

marco: We'll hold at 3% and block further ramps until ML validates tokenizer diffs. Filing short incident and adding notes to release page. Thanks for the quick response :thumbsup:
